propositions: Operator-attested evidence lacks deterministic enforcement of measurement-provenance context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type), allowing claims whose observation context contradicts project deployment facts to pass review.

Live API calls under broad privilege (bedrock:* wildcard identity) generate evidence structurally unable to fail and thus uninformative; policy simulators answer wrong questions (named-action syntax rather than service-enforced authorization checks) and produce confident wrong conclusions.

Plans asserting unchanged behavior across configuration swaps while citing no files on the consumption/resolution path avoid gate scrutiny because narrow scope reads as virtue, concealing four-hop dependencies like resolve_model path (config → workflow → step → verify.py:269) that invalidate the claim.

Measurement provenance must be recorded as queryable text (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) deterministically enforced by repo-grounded checks, not by re-running world measurements or LLM judgment of the measurement itself.
